MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub node enroll [options]

Log in and mint a durable node credential, storing it as this CLI's token
(enrollment without hand-copying a soon-to-expire PAT)

Options:
  --name <label>  Credential label (default: node-<hostname>)
  --server <url>  Server URL (default: configured server, else prompt)
  --show-token    Print the full node token once (default: masked prefix only)
  -h, --help      display help for command
